paragraphs: Creditspring’s mission to boost financial stability through short‑term products mirrors my focus on building reliable, user‑centric models that deliver tangible outcomes. I have crafted scikit‑learn pipelines and LSTM/BiRNN/CNN models in TensorFlow/Keras, deploying them as FastAPI services in Docker to ensure smooth integration and rapid iteration.

I proposed and prototyped an MCP‑based agentic tool in Python, utilising FastMCP, Ollama gpt‑oss:20b, PostgreSQL and GitHub Actions CI, for a Madrid‑based product start‑up client. The solution was showcased in a live stakeholder demo, demonstrating clear value and stakeholder engagement.
